scope: AIO2026 bounded main experiment; not a publication claim package
primary_question: How does plain-MLP hidden depth relate to observed gradient propagation under the frozen Fashion-MNIST training procedure?

aggregation_contract.layerwise_rms: For each hidden layer, arithmetic mean and median of per-probe RMS values.
aggregation_contract.raw_gap: For each probe: log10(G_last/G_first); summarize those per-probe gaps by mean and median.
aggregation_contract.normalized_gap: Per-probe raw gap divided by D-1; summarize by mean and median.
aggregation_contract.slope: Per-probe OLS slope of log10(layer RMS) against zero-based hidden-layer index; summarize by mean and median.
aggregation_contract.warning: Mean log-ratio is not log-ratio of arithmetic mean RMS values; both are exported under distinct names.

experimental_unit: One Fashion-MNIST image-label pair from a persisted stratified subset of the official training split.
split_policy: 10,000 training and 2,000 validation indices are sampled without overlap from the official training split; official test is untouched.
missingness_and_exclusion: Stop a primary run on non-finite loss/gradient/activation. Directional gain excludes and counts only denominators below 1e-6.
conditional_jacobian: Run only after 12 valid primary runs, and skip before sacrificing primary completion or exceeding 1,200 seconds.
stop_conditions: Stop before primary execution if tests fail or subset/order manifests cannot be saved.
Stop if the D=24 benchmark predicts primary completion cannot fit within 1,200 seconds.
Stop the affected run on NaN or Inf and preserve completed runs and logs.
Do not change optimizer, learning rate, depth, seed, steps, split, or checkpoint schedule after freeze.
Skip Jacobian measurements if the remaining runtime budget is insufficient.
v1_preservation: All protocol-v1, pilot-v1, audit and smoke artifacts remain immutable and use distinct paths.
code_revision_policy: The commit containing this frozen protocol is recorded in the run environment and log; no self-referential hash is embedded here.
ai_assistance: AI prepared implementation, checks, execution support and artifact packaging. The researcher owns interpretation and final conclusions.
